subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘PARK’ is coded as ‘3749’, and ‘RACE’ is coded as ‘4762’.How will ‘CARE’ be coded in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 ‘PARK’ is coded as ‘3749’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b84f53d2faf24fcabbc94f74617c49652e446ccb04f1ae38efb1ef6430a7c01.png] 

And,

‘RACE’ is coded as ‘4762’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0fa0e3da71ada6e6e598d084805ec7eae590420c77bd2a5c733bc3fba1b0918.png] 

So the code for C=6, A=7, R=4,E=2

Similarly,

‘**CARE’**’ = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41b7a88ed02fdfb5be4d4c7186898525b405db7af675ed1e4e08d10bccc85a0a.png] 

Hence, ‘CARE’’ is coded as "**6742**".
